title: Threads Intelligence Input
description: Pull posts from Meta Threads by handle, keyword, or post URL. Mix and match inputs in one run.

usernames.title: Threads handles
usernames.description: Public Threads handles to pull recent posts from. Leading @ is optional. Examples: zuck, mosseri, natemurray.

searchTerms.title: Search terms
searchTerms.description: Keyword searches against Threads. Returns top matching posts. Use brand names, product names, or topics for monitoring.

postUrls.title: Post URLs
postUrls.description: Specific post permalinks (https://www.threads.com/@user/post/CODE). Returns the post and any author engagement metrics rendered on the page.

minLikes.title: Minimum likes
minLikes.description: Drop posts with fewer likes. Useful for filtering noise on broad keyword searches. Set to 0 to keep everything.

verifiedOnly.title: Verified authors only
verifiedOnly.description: Keep only posts from accounts with the Meta verified badge.

maxItemsPerSource.title: Max posts per source
maxItemsPerSource.description: Cap on posts returned per handle, search term, or post URL.

maxItemsTotal.title: Max posts per run
maxItemsTotal.description: Hard cap across all sources. Controls total cost.

scrollPasses.title: Scroll passes
scrollPasses.description: Number of times to scroll the page to trigger lazy loaded posts. Each pass typically loads 5 to 10 more posts. Higher values cost more time per source.

dedupe.title: Deduplicate across runs
dedupe.description: Skip posts already pushed in previous runs (key is post code). Turn off to track engagement changes over time.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify proxy. Threads accepts datacenter for moderate volume. Switch to residential if you see soft blocks.
